descriptionInUI: Runs the 'GPS jamming' setting. A satellite-guided weapon (JDAM, JSOW, JASSM, SLAM-ER, KAB-S) released into a live jammer's bubble is detonated off its aimpoint, further off the deeper inside the bubble. Laser, TV and IR weapons are unaffected.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Chance a weapon inside the bubble is degraded (%)
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Rolled ONCE per weapon, the first tick it is inside a live jammer's reach. Below 100 some stores get through, so a package can still score hits inside a jammed area.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Terminal altitude the spoofed weapon is destroyed at (ft AGL)
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: The weapon flies its whole normal profile and is removed only this low, so the pilot sees the release, the fall and the detonation -- just in the wrong place.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Miss detonation size, as % of the weapon's own warhead
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: The miss detonates with the store's REAL explosive mass, so a 2000 lb JDAM craters like one and a 500 lb JDAM does not. 100 = the full warhead, which is what a bomb landing off-target actually does; lower it if you want a jammed pass to be less destructive than a clean miss.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Announce the first spoofed weapon to the firing flight
